in_marathi.name: Chandidaas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandidaas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandidaas is a Sanskrit name derived from the Moon God. The name signifies divinity, protection, and strength. In Hindu mythology, the Moon God, Chandra, is known to provide wisdom, tranquility, and prosperity.
